terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff between labor demanding total site preservation and management refusing to rule out closures.
Unresolved conflict with labor and state rejecting forced layoffs while management insists on keeping them as a fallback.
Unresolved disagreement as labor rejects review gates as hidden closure threats while capital views them as necessary operational discipline.
Live proposal range requiring costed scenario comparisons across no-closure, partial-footprint reduction, and closure-led paths.
